name_zh: 体重指数（遗传预测，孟德尔随机化）

overlap.rationale_zh: 与核心体脂领域为同一指标；MR 估计未按核心项校正，只按年龄、性别与地区，系数不超过 0.3

evidence.quote: In MR analyses, however, there were strong positive, log-linear associations with non-CVD (n = 4355) and all-cause (n = 6784) mortality at BMIs of ≥20 kg/m2 (Supplementary Figure S2, available as Supplementary data at IJE online), with each 5-kg/m2 increment associated with HRs of 1.59 (1.37–1.81) and 1.72 (1.55–1.89), respectively.
evidence.estimand_zh: 遗传预测的 BMI 每增加 5 kg/m2（BMI≥20 范围）的全因死亡风险（因果估计）；BMI<20 的常规分析偏低端风险多半是反向因果，MR 不支持，故只写拐点以上一侧，不写 hr_below

alternatives_considered.estimate: ACC 19队列 110万人 12万死亡，BMI 分组 U 形，摘要仅给'最高 1.5 倍、2.8 倍'无 HR+CI 成组
alternatives_considered.why_not: 观测性，低端受反向因果；摘要无可逐字核对的 HR/CI
人群以欧美为主且观测性；排序低于东亚 MR

alternatives_considered.estimate: CKB 常规分析 U 形，最低风险 25–29.9
alternatives_considered.why_not: 同文常规分析受反向因果，改取同文 MR
